name: Exp_Loco
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom 'Loco' indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator crosses above zero and sell positions when it crosses below one. It uses a new-bar detection mechanism to avoid redundant signals and supports configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit. The strategy operates on a configurable timeframe with separate toggles for opening and closing long/short positions.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义'Loco'指标的信号进行交易，当指标上穿0时开多仓，下穿1时开空仓。它使用新K线检测机制避免重复信号，支持可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈。策略在可配置的时间周期上运行，并可分别开关多空仓的开仓与平仓功能。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于自定义Loco指标的动量信号进行交易。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1的值从0变为大于0时触发买入信号，当该值从1变为小于1时触发卖出信号，本质上是一种动量交叉策略。出场条件包括：反向信号触发时平仓（买入信号时平空仓，卖出信号时平多仓），以及传统的止损和止盈方式。仓位管理通过MM参数控制手数比例，支持固定手数（LOT）和保证金模式两种方式。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数，将信号时间、手数、止损止盈等参数传递给交易执行模块。策略使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免Tick级别的重复交易，并通过BarsCalculated检查指标是否就绪。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA trades based on momentum signals from the custom Loco indicator. Entry conditions are: a buy signal triggers when indicator buffer 1's value transitions from 0 to above 0, and a sell signal triggers when it transitions from 1 to below 1, essentially forming a momentum crossover strategy. Exit conditions include closing positions on reverse signals (closing sells on buy signals and closing buys on sell signals), as well as traditional stop loss and take profit mechanisms. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter which sets the lot ratio, supporting both fixed lot (LOT) and margin-based modes. Money management relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library's BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen functions, passing signal time, lot size, stop loss, and take profit parameters to the trade execution module. The strategy uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, avoiding tick-level duplicate trades, and checks BarsCalculated to verify indicator readiness before proceeding.

pros: 多空方向分别控制开仓和平仓开关，灵活度高
使用新K线检测机制避免重复信号和过度交易
止损止盈参数可配置，提供基本的风险控制
支持多种价格类型输入，增强指标适应性
使用TradeAlgorithms库封装交易逻辑，代码结构清晰
pros_en: Separate toggle switches for buy/sell opening and closing provide high flexibility
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate signals and overtrading
Configurable stop loss and take profit parameters provide basic risk control
Support for multiple applied price types enhances indicator adaptability
Trade execution logic encapsulated in TradeAlgorithms library keeps code structure clean
cons: 依赖自定义Loco指标，指标逻辑不透明且无法审查
没有扩展的持仓检查，可能在已有持仓时重复开仓
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值较大，可能不适合所有品种
缺少点差过滤，在高位差环境下可能不利
信号判断逻辑过于简单（仅比较0和1），缺乏多层确认机制
cons_en: Depends on custom Loco indicator whose internal logic is opaque and unauditable
No explicit position check before opening new trades, risking duplicate positions
Default SL of 1000 and TP of 2000 points are large and may not suit all instruments
No spread filter, which could be detrimental in high-spread environments
Signal logic is overly simplistic (comparing only against 0 and 1), lacking multi-layer confirmation
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓
添加点差过滤条件，防止在高位差时入场
增加指标多重确认机制，提高信号可靠性
improvements_en: Add position check logic to prevent duplicate entries in the same direction
Add spread filter condition to avoid entering trades during high-spread periods
Implement multi-indicator confirmation mechanism to improve signal reliability

risk_points: 无显式持仓检查可能导致重复开仓
依赖外部自定义指标且逻辑不透明，存在黑箱风险
缺少点差过滤和滑点保护不足
risk_points_en: No explicit position check may lead to duplicate entries
Dependency on opaque custom indicator creates black-box risk
Lack of spread filter and insufficient slippage protection
